svg.title: E-commerce service map: AWS vs Azure vs Google Cloud
svg.text: The e-commerce service map: AWS vs Azure vs Google Cloud
The same thirteen building blocks every online shop needs, and the managed service each cloud gives you for it. First line is the default pick; second line is the alternative.
Shield Advanced for big DDoS events
WAF policy, bot rules, Private Link origins
on the global external Application LB
traffic into the cluster, partner APIs
API Gateway for mobile and partner APIs
ECS on Fargate if you skip Kubernetes
Cloud Run for services without Kubernetes
Bigtable for very high write rates
successor to Azure Cache for Redis
hot, cool, cold and archive tiers
Azure AD B2C is closed to new customers
Names as of November 2026. Icons are the official AWS, Azure and Google Cloud shapes that ship with draw.io. thecodeclouds.com
